jd:
Full-Stack Developer


About the Role


We’re looking for a Full-Stack Developer who is excited to build scalable, resilient systems and elegant user experiences at an early-stage startup. You’ll own features end-to-end — from design and architecture to implementation and refactoring — while balancing immediate delivery with long-term technical health.


This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, has a proactive mindset, and wants to shape both product and engineering foundations.


 


Responsibilities




Design and implement new features across frontend and backend.


Architect systems thoughtfully (DB schema, internal communication, data flows) to enable feature scalability and robustness.


Take ownership of delivering individual features end-to-end.


Monitor tech debt and drive proactive refactoring.


Make smart trade-offs between speed and scalability when implementing features.


Continuously refine systems to support future growth.




 


Requirements


Must-Haves




Full-stack development capability (even if frontend-leaning).


If experienced, at least 2 years tenure at a single organization is preferred.


History of internal promotion is strongly preferred.


Proactive in identifying problems before they occur and taking action.


High intrinsic intelligence with the ability to make sound short-term and long-term technical decisions.




 


Preferred Qualifications




Excitement about working in an early-stage startup.


Curiosity and enthusiasm for new technologies.


Experience in the fintech/payments space is a plus.


Hands-on experience with some of the following:




 


Frontend Stack




HTML/CSS


Tailwind


Svelte / SvelteKit


React


TypeScript




 


Backend & Infrastructure Stack




Go (Chi)


ConnectRPC/gRRC


Protobuf / Bufbuild


Temporal


AWS


Terraform


Git / GitHub


PostgreSQL




 


Why Join Us?




Impact from day one: Shape the foundations of both product and engineering.


Growth opportunities: Be part of a small, ambitious team where your contributions are recognized.


Challenging problems: Work on complex systems that require thoughtful design and proactive innovation.


Culture of ownership: We value people who take initiative and push boundaries.

job_name: Full Stack Software Engineering Internship (Onsite Tokyo, Japan)
jd:
We're moving!


HENNGE is tentatively scheduled to relocate our Tokyo headquarters from Shibuya to Shinjuku in April 2027. Depending on your batch, your internship will take place at either our current Shibuya hub or our brand-new Shinjuku office.


 


Begin the application process


Click here to register for the coding challenge (no time limit):


HENNGE’s Global Internship Program (GIP) is an on-site software engineering training program designed and run by HENNGE, a cloud security company based in Tokyo. The program is created for students and early-career engineers who want to strengthen their full-stack engineering skills in a global, English-speaking environment at our Tokyo headquarters.


This Full-Stack Pathway focuses on hands-on application development training across back-end, front-end, and basic DevOps, using Python (non-ML stack), Go, or TypeScript on the back-end and TypeScript with modern front-end frameworks on the front-end. The program emphasizes fundamental engineering skills, problem-solving, explanation, and collaboration, rather than production work.


Japanese is not required.


 


What You’ll Learn & Practice


During the program, you will:




Develop full-stack web applications as part of structured training projects


Build and connect back-end APIs and services with front-end applications


Practice key full-stack engineering concepts, including:



Back-end logic and API design


Front-end state management and data flow


Authentication and security basics


Software testing (unit, integration, end-to-end)






Learn, at a practical level, how front-end, back-end, and cloud infrastructure interact


Work with Unix-like environments and basic DevOps tooling


Explain your technical decisions, trade-offs, and problem-solving approach during discussions and reviews


Receive feedback from mentors and iteratively improve your implementation




 


Our Stance on AI and Software Engineering


AI tools can be helpful, but the goal of HENNGE’s Global Internship Program (GIP) is to help you build strong software engineering fundamentals.


To support that learning, we ask you not to use AI tools to generate code for training assignments or solution implementations. The code you submit should be written by you and reflect your own understanding.


You may use a designated AI service to support your learning in non-code-generating ways, such as clarifying technical concepts, understanding documentation, or helping with non-essential tasks (for example, command-line options).


Throughout the program, you’ll be expected to take ownership of your code and clearly explain your thinking, trade-offs, and design decisions. In this learning environment, you are the engineer and the final gatekeeper of quality.


Program Structure




Weeks 1-4: Full-Stack Application Development Project


Week 5: DevOps & Infrastructure Project




 


Internship Details




On-site program at HENNGE’s Shibuya office (Mon–Fri, 10:00–19:00 JST)


Mentorship and technical discussions with engineers based in the same office


English is the primary language used throughout the program




This program is not remote. Participants are expected to attend on-site.


 


Benefits




Round-trip airfares from and back to your country of residence


Pre-arrival support and visa guidance


Medical insurance* and a phone with mobile data will be provided during your internship in Tokyo, Japan**


Up to 150,000 JPY of monthly subsidy to cover accommodation, meals, transportation, and networking activities


Subsidized company events on top of monthly subsidy (Monthly Technical Sessions, Board Game Night, Get-to-know-you Lunches, and many others!) to get to know teams across divisions


Access to online learning platform during the internship period




* Medical insurance will only be provided to interns who do not reside in Japan


** This internship is an unpaid training program with a subsidy provided to all interns


 


Essential Qualifications




Third-year undergraduate or higher (including Master's and Doctoral students). Recent graduates are welcome to apply


Pursuing or holding a degree in Computer Science or a related field. If not, equivalent experience from a tech internship or bootcamp is expected


Fluency in English (Japanese not required)


Proficiency in Python, Go, or React/Vue in TypeScript


Knowledge of Linux / MacOS / Unix-like environments


Interested in open source or tech community activities


Interested in pursuing a career in Japan




At least meet three of the following:




Experience in cloud computing platforms, especially AWS


Experience in full stack web application development


Knowledge of distributed systems


Knowledge of DevOps tools and practices (CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code)


Knowledge of Container technology (e.g. Docker)




 


Our Ideal Candidate


Our ideal full stack engineering intern is a curious problem-solver who’s excited to build real-world applications and grow in a fast-paced tech environment. We’re especially interested in candidates who:




Are proficient in Python, Go, and React/Vue in TypeScript


Are comfortable working in Unix-like environments


Have a solid grasp of both front-end and back-end development


Have an interest in cloud computing and DevOps practices


Are passionate about learning, contributing to tech communities, and possibly pursuing a career in Japan




Bring your curiosity, versatility, and drive—we’re excited to see what you can build with us.


 


Internship schedule


We open batches multiple times a year.


Available batch (as of June 9th)




Batch 1 (2027): Jan 18 - Feb 19 (5 weeks)


Batch 2 (2027): Jun 1 - Jul 16 (7 weeks)


Batch 3 (2027): Aug 2 - Sep 3 (5 weeks)




 


How to apply




Register through the apply button below and verify your email address.


Solve the coding challenge and submit your work with your CV and cover letter.


An HR interview, followed by a final interview, will be given to those who pass Step 2.




Before you apply: Your CV and cover letter are your chance to show us your story. Clear, thoughtful explanations of your experiences will make your application stronger, while generic submissions may not fully reflect your potential.


 


Notice for Applicants




A limited number of internship slots are available. Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and positions will be filled on a first-come, first-served basis. We encourage you to apply early, as applications will close once all positions are filled.


The coding challenge has no time limit, and the screening process will not consider solving time. Please note that the application is completed after uploading application documents and filling in the batch preferences.


Please take another challenge if you are (also) interested in applying for HENNGE’s GIP Front-end Engineering Pathway. Please use different emails to sign up if you apply for both internships.

jd:
About the Position


We are looking for an engineer experienced with Elixir to join us! In this role, you’ll have an opportunity to contribute and create awesome features for several e-commerce products using Elixir with the Phoenix framework and PostgreSQL.


As a small, self-funded company with around 10 members on our engineering team, you’ll have an opportunity to really make an impact and grow as engineer. As such, we are looking for someone who has both excellent technical knowledge and skills while also taking initiative, challenging themselves by tackling complex problems with confidence and care.


Our team loves functional programming and is always excited about the Elixir ecosystem. We’re always looking for new ways to apply the unique benefits of Elixir and its underlying Erlang VM to elegantly solve new business problems. If the above describes you, we are eager to speak with you.


 


Responsibilities




Write readable, maintainable and performant Elixir code


Regularly document and test modules and functions


Be able to work independently and see projects through from conception to completion


Proactively collaborate with team members to complete tasks and projects


Participate in code reviews and adhere to coding standards and best practices




 


Required Qualifications




At least 2 years of experience as a software engineer


Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms and system design


Experience with database design and writing performant SQL queries using PostgreSQL


Highly motivated and independent


Strong communication and teamwork abilities




 


Preferred Quilifications




Previous professional experience with Elixir and commonly used packages in its ecosystem, such as Oban, Oban Pro, Broadway, and more


Experience developing applications for Shopify


Experience building web applications with Phoenix LiveView


Experience with cloud service providers like AWS (preferred), Azure, GCP, etc.


Experience with front-end technologies such as React (preferred), Vue or Angular


Past experience developing mobile applications with React Native


A degree in computer science or other related field




 


Hiring Process





Online Interview with Founder and Senior Engineer(s) - 30min



We’ll discuss your engineering background and past experience, and give you a chance to learn more about our company.







Technical assignment



You’ll have a chance to show off your technical skills by completing a small assignment. You have some freedom in what language(s) and technologies you use to complete this assignment, so don’t sweat it if you’ve never used Elixir before!







In-person or remote interview with the team - 90-120min



If you’re currently based in Japan, you’ll have an opportunity to enjoy lunch or dinner (on us!) at our office in Kichijoji. If you’re based outside of Japan, we’ll have a group video call. Either way, this will be a chance to meet and talk with members from various teams at our company. After that, there will be a technical interview with our engineers where you’ll discuss your solution to the above technical assignment as well as discuss other technical topics.

company_info: FLYWHEEL aims to build a society where everyone can freely and effectively use data through “Conata™,” an enterprise data utilization platform.
jd:
ミッション


「データを人々のエネルギーに」
フライウィールは、データとAIを活用して人々の可能性を最大限に引き出し、新たな価値を創造することを使命としています。30年後の子どもたちが「成長」と「挑戦」を当たり前に楽しめる、制約のない社会の実現を目指します。


 


フライウィールについて


米国ビッグテック企業出身の経営陣により設立され、企業のデータ戦略立案からシステム導入、活用支援までをワンストップで提供しています。独自のデータ活用プラットフォーム「Conata™」を軸に、エンタープライズ企業の収益拡大を支援するプロフェッショナル集団です。


 


プロダクト：Conata™（コナタ）


データの収集から分析、生成AI（RAG）を活用した知識検索、AIエージェントによる業務自動化までを一貫して支援するプラットフォームです。2024年には、膨大な社内データを自然言語で横断検索できる「Conata Data Agent」をリリースし、企業の高度なDataOpsを実現しています。


 


配属予定チーム




Product Architectチーム：プロダクトの基幹設計・開発・保守。


Core Technologyチーム：技術の一貫性・効率・革新の促進。


Technical Planning & Enablementチーム：開発プランニング、品質改善、デリバリー支援。




 


業務内容




フロントエンド・BFF：Conataの共通ライブラリ開発、UI/UX設計、案件向けカスタマイズ。


データエンジニアリング：ETL/ELT処理の開発、パイプライン構築、データウェアハウス（DWH）の設計。


バックエンド・インフラ：API開発、高負荷対策、セキュリティ対策、Amazon EKS等を用いたシステム運用。


開発基盤：開発ツールチェインの最適化、社内情報管理ツールの開発。




 


開発環境




クラウド：AWS


言語：Kotlin, Python, TypeScript


技術スタック：React, Next.js, MySQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Snowflake, gRPC, Apache pulsar, Amazon EKS (Kubernetes), Terraform, Bazel


SaaS：Auth0, Vercel




 


応募要件


必須条件




Java, Kotlin, Python, TypeScript等、1つ以上の言語を用いた実務開発経験。


API/Webアプリの開発運用経験、またはフロントエンド開発経験（1年以上）。


コンピューターサイエンスに関する基礎知識。




 


歓迎条件




CS、AI、機械学習分野の修士・博士号。


AWS等のクラウド環境やIDaaS（Auth0等）を用いた認証基盤の開発経験。


Docker / Kubernetesを用いたサーバー運用経験。


高負荷対策やスケーラビリティに関する知識。




 


本ポジションの魅力




クライアントのビジネス課題を技術で解決する、手応えのあるプロジェクトに携われる。


インフラからデータエンジニアリングまで、各領域のスペシャリストと高め合える環境。


新しい技術へのチャレンジを推奨する文化があり、技術選定から運用まで幅広く経験できる。

job_name: Software Engineer, LINK Connectors (1 Year Contract)
jd:
Role Description


The LINK Ecosystem connects our data platform to over 2,600 data sources across Japan. Engineers on the LINK Connectors team develop API-based ETL software powering the data aggregation system at the core of the company's fintech platform. We integrate directly with the APIs published by financial institutions as part of Japan's open banking ecosystem, manage the OAuth2 authorizations behind those connections, and deliver clean, consistent financial data through our import pipeline.


 

Key Responsibilities




Developing and maintaining API-based ETL pipelines for resilient data aggregation systems


Adding new financial institutions through their APIs, including OAuth2 authorization and token lifecycle management


Creating tools to accelerate resolution of data aggregation issues


Mapping institution API responses to our internal data models


Collaborating with peers on technical solutions


Handling customer support requests and implementing system improvements




 

Required Experience




Proficiency writing maintainable TypeScript or JavaScript code


Commitment to technical excellence with openness to peer feedback


Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively


Strong English communication skills


Strong interest in financial products and services




 

Preferred Experience




3+ years experience coding in Ruby, in a hobbyist or professional capacity


Professional or hobbyist experience building serverless applications on AWS or similar services


Experience integrating with third-party REST APIs and OAuth2 flows


Business Japanese proficiency

company_info:
ExaWizards is an AI start-up  with a simple mission: solve social issues using AI and create a happy society.  But to achieve it, they’re tackling issues across a wide variety of industries: Care tech, HR, fintech, medicine, security and more.  They believe AI can help solve problems in all these areas, and they’re determined to do just that.



Their business model can be broken into two different flows:  project-focused and product-focused.   For project-focused initiatives, they start from scratch.  Their ML engineers and consultants identify business problems and build models aimed at solving them.



In their product flow, they take the ML models developed for specific problems and generalize them to be useful for a wider array of problems.  Normally they develop these solutions into SaaS products.

company_info: Estie aims to solve the challenges of real estate transaction costs caused by data fragmentation.
jd:
Background


Real estate is deeply connected to nearly every aspect of our daily lives. Whether it's shopping malls, hotels, logistics warehouses powering e-commerce, or data centers supporting the digital world, economic activity always takes place somewhere. At estie, we view real estate as the foundation where economic activity happens, and we're committed to improving people's lives through data and technology.


Commercial real estate—including office buildings, logistics facilities, and shopping centers—is one of the largest asset classes in the world. Tokyo holds the largest stock of institutionally owned commercial real estate globally, making Japan one of the world's most important markets. Despite its scale, much of the industry's information remains fragmented and difficult to access, creating inefficiencies that limit better decision-making and urban development.


At estie, our mission is to transform the commercial real estate industry by making information, operations, and transactions more seamless through technology and data. By unlocking the hidden value of cities, we aim to contribute to the long-term growth of Japan's economy and society.


As we continue to grow, we're investing in the next generation of engineers who will become future technical leaders at estie. We're looking for people with strong learning ability and potential, even if they have limited professional experience in web development.


 


What You'll Do


As a Junior Web Application Engineer, you'll build a strong foundation in web development while learning how to create business value through software.


From your first day, you'll work on real product features with support from experienced engineers. Over time, you'll be expected to grow rapidly, taking on larger technical challenges and contributing to new product development and business problem-solving alongside senior engineers.


 


What You'll Learn




Gain deep knowledge of the commercial real estate industry through hands-on product development


Work with multiple languages and products, including Rust, TypeScript, and Ruby


Learn directly from senior engineers through design discussions and code reviews


Develop both technical and business skills by working closely with customers, product managers, designers, and engineers


Participate in building products from idea generation through implementation




 


Responsibilities




Develop new features that deliver value to customers


Improve existing systems through technical initiatives and performance optimizations


Explore ideas, build prototypes, and run proof-of-concept projects using large-scale real estate datasets


Contribute to the launch of new products and projects


Continuously improve both your technical skills and the effectiveness of your team




 


Team & Mentorship


Every engineer who joins estie is assigned a mentor, and junior engineers receive especially hands-on support during onboarding.


Your mentor will help you learn development fundamentals, including Git workflows, frontend-backend collaboration, and development best practices. They will also serve as your primary point of contact for questions and help clarify expectations as you grow. Our goal is for new engineers to make their first production deployment within their first one to two weeks.


You'll join a cross-functional team of approximately five members, including web application engineers, product managers, designers, and design engineers. The environment is highly collaborative, with easy access to senior engineers and strong code review practices that support continuous learning.


You'll also have opportunities to seek guidance from the company CTO and Business Unit CTOs.


 


Tech Stack


Frontend




Next.js


React


TypeScript




 


Backend


Depending on the product, one or more of the following stacks are used:




Rust + Actix Web + Async GraphQL


Ruby on Rails


TypeScript + Node.js + NestJS




GraphQL is used as the primary interface between frontend and backend services.


For internal analytics tools:




Python


Streamlit




 


Development Tools




GitHub


GitHub Actions


Sentry


Datadog


Jira


Slack


GitHub Copilot


Claude Code


Cursor


Devin


Codex




 




Minimum Qualifications


Candidates must meet at least one of the following requirements:




Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, or another STEM field


Graduation from a Japanese National College of Technology (KOSEN) or completion of an advanced engineering program


Publicly available personal projects or open-source contributions




Public projects include software or products accessible to users other than yourself, such as GitHub repositories, web services, mobile applications, CLI tools, libraries, or applications published through app stores.




Proven achievements in competitive programming or data science competitions, such as:



AtCoder Blue rating or above


Kaggle Competitions Expert or above


Advancement beyond the domestic qualification round of ICPC


Awards or equivalent achievements in similar competitions









 


Preferred Qualifications


Development Experience






Frontend development experience using JavaScript frameworks such as React, Vue.js, or Angular

company_info: Owndays is a leading eyewear company that offers a wide range of high-quality spectacles to customers worldwide.
jd:
About The Company


OWNDAYS (part of Lenskart) is a leading eyewear company that offers a wide range of high-quality spectacles to customers worldwide. Established in Tokyo, Japan in 1989, the company has grown to over 500 stores in 13 countries worldwide and has become one of the most trusted and innovative eyewear brands in many parts of the world. The company's success is a testament to its commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction.


 


Company Mission


Our mission goes beyond just providing clear vision; we aim to enrich our customers' lives by offering glasses that enhance their daily experiences. Committed to exploring new demands and services from Japan to the world, OWNDAYS continuously takes on the challenge of innovation. We are committed to providing customers with the highest quality products at the most affordable prices. With over 1,500 styles of frames available in-store and online, customers can choose from a vast selection of designs to suit their unique style and personality.


 


About The Role


We are looking for a  Ecommerce Product Manager (Junior–Mid level) to support the planning, coordination, and execution of campaigns and product launches across OWNDAYS’ online properties. This role sits at the intersection of marketing, merchandising, design, and development, and is responsible for ensuring requirements are clearly consolidated, timelines are managed, and releases happen smoothly and on time across regions.


This is a hands-on coordination and delivery role, ideal for someone who has experience managing web projects or campaigns and wants to grow into a broader online leadership position.


Native or fluent in Japanese (N1) and conversational English is a must.


 


What your responsibilities will be




Own the end-to-end online/web release timeline for campaigns, promotions, and new product launches across multiple regions


Work closely with global merchandising, branding, marketing, retail, design, and development teams to gather and consolidate requirements


Translate campaign and business requirements into clear deliverables and execution plans


Coordinate schedules, dependencies, and approvals to ensure on-time publishing across all online properties


Act as the main point of contact for online-related execution during campaign planning and launch phases


Ensure content, visuals, pricing, and promotional mechanics are accurately reflected on site at launch


Identify risks to timelines early and proactively propose solutions or adjustments


Support post-launch checks and issue management to ensure stable performance


Help improve internal processes, documentation, and workflows related to web releases and campaign execution




 


Minimum Qualifications:




2–5 years of experience in web operations, web project management, digital marketing, or e-commerce


Experience with SEO and working with Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics


Experience working with cross-functional teams (marketing, design, development, merchandising, etc.)


Strong organizational and timeline management skills, with attention to detail


Basic understanding of website structures, CMS workflows, and digital production processes


Comfortable managing multiple initiatives in parallel across different stakeholders and regions


Clear communication skills in a professional business environment


Native-level Japanese required; conversational English is required.


Exposure to e-commerce platforms, CMS tools, or project management tools




 


Nice to Have:




Experience working in a global or multi-regional organization


Experience supporting product launches or large-scale campaigns


Interest in fashion, retail, or consumer brands

jd:

ポジション概要　Position Overview

「LINE」サービス全般におけるローカライゼーション・UXライティングプロジェクトの進行管理と品質管理を担当します。

依頼対応からスケジュール調整、翻訳管理システムでのアサイン、成果物の検収・納品までを一貫して行い、LQA（Linguistic Quality Assurance・言語品質チェック）や言語面のバグ修正、アウトソース管理も行います。

You will be responsible for project progress management and quality control for localization and UX writing projects across LINE services. This includes handling incoming requests, coordinating schedules, assigning tasks in the translation management system, inspecting deliverables, and completing final delivery. You will also oversee LQA (Linguistic Quality Assurance), fix language-related bugs, and manage outsourced vendors.

 

組織のミッション・展望　Mission and Vision of the Team

UX Localizationチームでは、「LINE」関連サービスのUIを安定して・高品質に・すばやくライティング・ローカライズすることをミッションとしています。

安定：スケジュールを守る、テキストの質も安定させる

高品質：サービスを使う人が操作しやすいテキストを書く

すばやく：品質とスピードを両立する

The UX Localization Team’s mission is to provide stable, high-quality, and fast writing and localization for LINE-related service UIs.

Stability: Meet deadlines and maintain consistent text quality

High quality: Write text that makes services easy for users to understand and operate

Speed: Deliver both quality and speed at the same time

 

主な業務内容　Main Responsibilities

具体的には以下の業務を想定しています。

サービス企画者から案件を受注

進行管理（依頼内容・スケジュールの確認など）

各言語の担当者からの質問に対し、自ら対応・依頼者への確認・接続などを通してサポート

提出物の検収

成果物の納品

コミュニケーションツールはおもにSlack（チャットツール）上で実施

上記に加え、以下の業務も行います。

LQAの実施※

バグ修正：バグ管理システム（Bug Tracking System）に登録された言語面の問題を修正

アウトソース先の管理（品質管理、フィードバック、サポート、契約、支払いなど）

※実作業は各言語の担当者をアサインします

LINEサービスでは最大19言語への対応しており、まずはソース言語（原文）のレビューまたはUXライティングを行ったうえで多言語ローカライズを進めます。依頼の種類により業務内容は一部異なることがありますが、基本的な業務フローは概ね共通です。

※変更の範囲：会社の定める全ての業務への配置転換の可能性あり

 

The role is expected to include the following work:

Receive project requests from service planners

Manage project progress, including confirming request details and schedules

Conduct information intake sessions and kickoff meetings depending on the request

Assign work to language owners, including outsourced resources

Assignments are managed using the translation management system XTM

Communication is primarily handled via Slack

 

In addition to the above, you will also:

Conduct LQA

Fix language-related issues registered in the bug tracking system

Manage outsourcing partners, including quality control, feedback, support, contracts, and payments

For LQA, the hands-on work is assigned to the person in charge of each language. LINE services support up to 19 languages. In principle, multilingual localization proceeds after reviewing the source language text or conducting UX writing for the original content. Depending on the type of request, some parts of the work may differ, but the basic workflow is generally the same.

company_info: Estie aims to solve the challenges of real estate transaction costs caused by data fragmentation.
jd:
Background


estie has built one of the largest office real estate databases in Japan and develops and operates multiple products based on this data. Because data itself serves as a powerful competitive advantage in our business, we place a strong emphasis on data engineering.


To enable multiple product teams to collect, process, and store data with both high quality and speed, while also allowing teams to safely leverage data created by other products, we are building an internal data management platform.


To drive the development and continuous improvement of this platform, we are seeking a Data Engineer who can build a high-level data foundation based on solid knowledge and experience in data engineering.


 


Responsibilities




Development and Operation of the Data Platform, and Promotion of Data Management



We are looking for someone to contribute to the development and operation of our Snowflake-based data platform, which powers the data pipelines used to maintain and manage real estate data.


As this platform handles data that is extremely critical to our business, you will also be responsible for formulating and promoting data management policies, including data security and data governance, so that users can utilize data with confidence.






Initiatives to Improve Internal Operations Through the Use of the Data Platform



You will support the use of data to improve the operational efficiency of internal teams, including Corporate, Sales, and Customer Success.


More recently, we have been integrating SaaS products used by the Customer Success team with our internal data platform, while designing and developing data structures that enable seamless data utilization.






Building and Operating Internal Analytics Infrastructure and BI Dashboards



You will contribute to the development and operation of analytics infrastructure that enables business teams, including Sales and Customer Success, to analyze internally accumulated real estate data and deliver value to customers through reporting, consulting, and other services.


You will also be involved in building and operating BI dashboards used daily by management and business teams such as Sales to visualize key business metrics, including revenue.








 


What Makes This Position Exciting / What You Will Gain


Be involved in developing a forward-looking real estate data analytics platform


You will have the opportunity to work on the development of a data analytics platform that directly supports customer value creation through real estate data-driven reporting, consulting, and related services.


Specifically, you will take on highly challenging initiatives such as building data marts that allow business members without deep SQL expertise to work with data using simple SQL, providing standardized data analysis applications, and creating more ad hoc analytics environments by leveraging technologies such as generative AI and LLMs. At the same time, you will also help build mechanisms to ensure the quality of outputs.


 


Focus on new development and feature enhancements for KPI dashboards that are still evolving


While our BI dashboards have already contributed to business growth by supporting data-driven decision-making, there remains significant room for further development, including the addition of new features and improvements to existing functionality.


Because the platform has been designed and implemented with a strong emphasis on minimizing operational burden, it runs in a highly stable manner with almost no day-to-day incidents. This allows the team to focus on new development and feature enhancements for the data platform, rather than routine maintenance.


 


Play a central role in company-wide data utilization and business growth


In this role, you will serve as a core member in the development of data platforms used across the company, including advanced analytics platforms and management KPI dashboards. You will collaborate closely with a wide range of teams, including executive leadership, Corporate, business teams, and product development, while contributing broadly to the business.


Rather than simply responding to user requests, you will be deeply involved from the early stages of new business initiatives powered by data. From planning through delivery, you will have the opportunity to contribute end-to-end and play a meaningful role in driving the business forward.


 


Technical Environment




DWH: Snowflake


ETL/ELT: Fivetran, dbt


IaC: Terraform


BI: Tableau, Streamlit in Snowflake


Code Management: GitHub


CI/CD: GitHub Actions


Task Management: JIRA


Communication Tools: Slack


Other: GitHub Copilot




 


Requirements




Experience in designing, developing, and operating data platforms using data warehouses such as Snowflake and BigQuery, as well as ETL/ELT processes


Hands-on experience in working with databases and data warehouses using SQL and/or Python


Experience in collaborating with both internal and external team members to discuss and define business goals




 


Preferred Skills




Experience in developing and operating solutions using modern data stack technologies such as Snowflake and dbt


Knowledge of and development experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure


Experience in managing infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform


Experience in developing solutions using BI tools such as Tableau and Looker




 


Ideal Candidate Profile




Someone who is motivated to take on challenging issues such as data management in a time when the role of data platforms is undergoing significant change through the adoption of generative AI and LLMs


Someone who is interested in proactive, business-driving data utilization that goes beyond supporting internal decision-making


Someone who is interested in designing and building a sustainable data platform that does not place an excessive operational burden on those responsible for maintenance and operations


Someone who, from the standpoint of developing and operating the data platform that supports business-critical data pipelines, is interested in initiatives such as improving the developer experience of the platform

company_info: Artytech is a Tokyo-based creative development studio that supports small and mid-sized businesses through custom-built websites, apps, internal systems, and web marketing solutions.
jd:
About Artytech


At Artytech, we support small and medium-sized businesses with web development, digital marketing, and operational solutions that go beyond templates. Based in Koenji, Tokyo, we combine hands-on development with practical business understanding to deliver value.


We’re a small but highly flexible team, working closely with our clients to create web applications, landing pages, and tailor-made digital tools.
If you enjoy building things from scratch, working autonomously, and being part of a team where your voice matters, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re also looking for someone who can understand database structures and query logic, and manage multiple tasks efficiently in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.
